lesson: The v6 expensive-compilation obstruction was representation-specific on this constructed family. A factor-DAG representation discovered from the CNF interaction graph compiled the same style of exact boundary relation far more cheaply than a global ROBDD.
limitation: Success is explained by bounded discovered local interaction width (scope<=3, internal component<=3). Component size/local width growth remains untested.
